# `browser-extension/services/NavigationService.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/NavigationService.js`

NavigationService.js — webNavigation history + OS push events. Runs in the extension background service worker context. The background registers webNavigation listeners that call NavigationService.addEvent(). The OS can poll history() or receive live push events via the __os_bridge_event__ channel.

## Constants

- `NavigationService`
